name: linear-lens
description: Make Linear issue IDs like ENG-123 clickable, hoverable, and useful inside VS Code.

linearLens.workspaceSlug.markdownDescription: Your Linear workspace slug, used to build issue URLs like `https://linear.app/<slug>/issue/ENG-123`. Find it in your Linear URL.

linearLens.teamKeys.markdownDescription: Optional allowlist of team keys to recognize (e.g. `["ENG", "DESIGN"]`). When empty, any `ABC-123`-shaped token (2–7 letters) is treated as an issue ID.

linearLens.markers.markdownDescription: Actionable marker keywords. A reference on a line containing one of these (or an unchecked `- [ ]` task) is treated as actionable and can appear in the Problems panel. Matched case-insensitively with word boundaries.

linearLens.diagnostics.enable.description: Surface actionable, marker-bound Linear references in the Problems panel. Raw references in prose are never reported.

linearLens.diagnostics.severity.description: Severity used for marker-bound Linear references in the Problems panel.

linearLens.links.enable.description: Turn recognized issue references into clickable document links.

linearLens.hover.enable.description: Show hover cards for issue references.

linearLens.decorations.enable.description: Visibly highlight recognized issue references in the editor.

linearLens.statusBar.enable.description: Show a status bar item for the Linear issue detected in the current git branch.

linearLens.api.enable.markdownDescription: Fetch live issue metadata (title, status, assignee, priority, project) for richer hovers when signed in or a personal API key is set. Acts as a master kill-switch: when off, hovers stay basic even when authenticated.

linearLens.cache.ttlSeconds.description: How long (in seconds) to cache fetched issue metadata before refetching.

linearLens.auth.clientId.markdownDescription: Your Linear OAuth application's **Client ID** (from Linear → Settings → API → OAuth applications). Required to sign in with Linear. No client secret is needed — Linear Lens uses the PKCE flow.

linearLens.auth.redirectPort.markdownDescription: Local loopback port for the OAuth callback. Register `http://localhost:<port>/callback` as the redirect URI in your Linear OAuth application (exact match required). Run **Linear Lens: Show Authentication Status** to see the exact URL.
